body:
Radio Rubben needs a separate VPS test environment without affecting WordPress, Studio production, DNS or radio operations.

VPS 5363103 is running Ubuntu 24.04 LTS with PHP/Nginx/MariaDB and Node.js 24.22.0 LTS/npm 11.19.1. Studio and WordPress use separate data, system users and PHP pools. PHP workers cannot reach external networks or send email; production credentials and data were not copied.

The isolated environment is active on standard HTTPS: Studio at https://5.249.252.78 and WordPress at https://5.249.252.78/wordpress/. Both login pages are verified in Cloud Browser. Full redirect-chain checks now prevent internal ports leaking into login URLs. The unused 8443 listener and firewall opening were removed. Certificate renewal dry-run passed, confirmed in Certbot's log. Actual infrastructure runtime: 551a476.

Validation on the VPS: Studio's full Composer test suite, all six Node robot tests, authentication gates, private-file isolation, blocked outgoing PHP traffic/mail, PHP/Bash syntax, and HTTPS redirect checks. User sign-in with the final password and journeys inside the apps remain to be tested by the owner. No Node worker is running.

During post-install review, WP-CLI --prompt was found to echo the first test password. Test access was suspended, password handling moved to host-bound PHP helpers over stdin, and the owner completed a new hidden password entry. Both credentials were rotated and old sessions invalidated before access reopened. No secret value is included in this PR. Tests using synthetic input confirmed no input echo on valid and invalid validation paths.

Studio still hardcodes production WordPress endpoints, so that integration stays disconnected. AI/TTS, Radio.co, OneDrive, payments and customer email are not connected. The production Fotballrobot directory is absent from the checked web-main and is not recreated from an unverified branch.

This draft is for review and traceability. Do not merge as part of this task: main has a production deployment workflow. Existing workflows and production application code are unchanged. docs/UNIWEB-VPS-TEST.md records results, the credential incident and remaining limitations.
